title: Signal: Possible an IPMI password passed with -P in source
scope: One line, matching an IPMI password passed with -P.
limitations: Shape-only: one tool-specific invocation carrying a credential-shaped literal. It cannot prove the credential is live, and it does not resolve values assembled at run time.

examples.line: ipmitool -H bmc -U admin -P Zq7mKp4tQQQQQQQQQQQQ power status

fpNotes: Documentation and test scripts that show the tool with a placeholder value are the common false positives; the pattern requires a shaped literal and vetoes EXAMPLE text.
